generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

[[ if test="member(1, ta_index)" ]]

The correct answer is used in controlling Births in a nation.

The use of birth control measures in a nation involves implementing strategies and methods to regulate and limit the number of births, contributing to population management and family planning, distinct from the statistical record-keeping aspect of vital statistics.

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(2, ta_index)" ]]

The correct answer is used in shaping the direction of politics in a nation.

Public discourse and civic engagement serve as influential forces in shaping the trajectory of a nation's politics, emphasizing the power of informed discussions and active participation beyond the confines of vital statistics.

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(3, ta_index)" ]]

The correct answer is used for doing mass vaccination.

Mass vaccination refers to the large-scale administration of vaccines to a population, typically employed during public health crises, aiming to achieve widespread immunity against infectious diseases, distinct from the collection and analysis of vital statistics.

[[/ if ]]
